scope: All original CN variants and their QCP migrations, plus existing constructed variants and archived input/result evidence
source_match_policy: Exact source/goal/input hashes when available; weaker manifest/case associations labelled explicitly. Never move a PASS, counterexample or measurement to a changed contract/input silently.
unknown_policy: Preserve UNKNOWN, errors, residual manual obligations, missing measurements and prepared-only inputs. No invented PASS or zero resource usage.
legacy_generators: Frozen seven-slot generation scripts remain for historical reproduction only; they do not impose the current admission policy.
